text:
oliver: Quick idea — meet at Shadow Park after work for a tiny taco + mini-quiz night? low-key, BYO blanket. :taco: :sparkles:
maria: love this. what day/time? i can bring chips + salsa. :yum:
sam: friday sounds great for me, 6pm?
lee: 6pm works. can someone check if the picnic tables are free?
tia: i'll bring a tiny speaker and a 10-question trivia (mostly dumb pop culture). happy to MC. :microphone:
jax: in for tacos. i'm allergic to peanuts fyi (not common in tacos but heads-up).
oliver: noted re: peanuts. plan: Friday 6pm at the east-side lawn by the fountain. bring one snack or drink to share. quick poll — who can bring plates/napkins/utensils?
maria: i can bring disposable plates + napkins.
sam: i'll grab forks/serving spoons.
lee: i'll double-check table availability at 5:30 and post here.
office-bot: Reminder: park permit not required for groups under 25.
tia: also thinking of a tiny prize for quiz winner — a $10 coffee shop card? ok?
jax: yes please, works for me.
oliver: sweet. final RSVP? (so we know how many tacos to order)  — maria, sam, lee, tia, jax, oliver = 6. anyone else? @everyone feel free to drop a +1. :raised_hands:
maria: +1 partner maybe? i'll confirm tomorrow.
sam: also can we do a tiny sign that says "Redwood Tiny Taco Quiz"? low effort.
lee: lol yes. i'll bring a sharpie
oliver: perfect — i'll place taco order for ~8 and add a vegetarian option. see y'all friday! :taco:
